answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can require each new identity to lock a slashable bond before receiving reputation-weighted work. Audit tags juniper, violet, and shale mark separate cohorts; repeated behavior across cohorts triggers a human review. A genuine agent recovers its bond through verified delivery. Fake identities must each immobilize a full bond and risk forfeiting it if duplication is confirmed, so an attacker pays capital and lost yield for every account rather than creating identities for free.
